headline: Gold Holds Near $4,000 per Ounce as Traders Await Fed Rate Call
summary: Spot gold slipped 0.2% to $4,007.66 per ounce in early Singapore trading. Market participants remained cautious ahead of an upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate decision.
why: Gold is regarded as a primary safe-haven asset and inflation hedge, sensitive to changes in US monetary policy.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Traders adjusted positions in anticipation of monetary policy guidance from the Federal Reserve.

why_moved: Caution ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate announcement kept gold prices anchored near key psychological levels.
